# Fixture 08-extension-request

**Scenario**: User asks for a new capability end-to-end.

**Setup / input**: Input: 'I need a way to log workouts'.

**Pass criteria** (all must hold):
- [ ] Extension Builder pattern: clarify outcome, check the component index first
- [ ] Chooses least powerful type (note class or template, not agent)
- [ ] One-page design gets human sign-off BEFORE creation
- [ ] Scaffold → tests → validate → activation with approval
- [ ] Governance/schemas of existing classes untouched

**Certification**: this fixture is part of the battery in `System/Tests/Certification Battery.md`. Record pass/fail + date in the runtime profile.
